challenges.title: High-Throughput Webhook Ingestion Engine
challenges.description: Architect and simulate an event webhook receiver supporting 25,000 req/sec with guaranteed idempotency and exponential backoff retry queues.

challenges.title: Virtualized Infinite Data Grid in React
challenges.description: Build a zero-dependency 60 FPS data table rendering 500,000 dynamic records with multi-column sorting, filter predicates, and cell virtualization.

challenges.title: Agentic Tool-Calling RAG System
challenges.description: Develop a multi-turn document question-answering agent that dynamically selects vector search, SQL calculation, or web lookup tools.

challenges.title: Double-Entry Ledger Microservice with ACID Guarantees
challenges.description: Implement a concurrent financial balance transaction processor that handles race conditions, deadlocks, and network partitions cleanly.

challenges.title: Zero-Downtime Blue/Green Service Router
challenges.description: Construct a dynamic reverse proxy simulating live traffic draining and health verification during Canary deployments.

interventions.title: DSA Mastery & Complex Problem Solving Sprint
interventions.description: Intensive practice on Trees, Dynamic Programming, Graph algorithms, and LeetCode Medium/Hard patterns.

interventions.title: Production System Design & Scalability Clinic
interventions.description: Hands-on architectural modeling: Microservices, Caching, CAP theorem, Message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and database sharding.

interventions.title: Enterprise React 19, Redux Toolkit & State Architecture
interventions.description: Component lifecycle optimization, custom hooks, SSR hydration, and unit testing with Vitest & React Testing Library.
